description:
BSN SPORTS, A VARSITY BRANDS COMPANY - THE RECOGNIZED LEADER IN TEAM ATHLETIC GEAR 
 For over 50 years, BSN SPORTS has been the largest team sporting goods equipment and apparel distributor of choice in the United States .  Our 3,000 BSN SPORTS employees strive to support the Heart of the Game by putting valuable time back into the day of coaches and administrators through excellent service platforms. Our company mission is simple: Save coaches and administrators time with everything they do off the field so they have more time to impact young lives on it.
 
 
 
 LOCATION: REMOTE 

 HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT: 

 Varsity Brands is building a modern, unified digital platform that powers the full experience of sport and spirit , enabling seamless workflows across product configuration, ordering, fulfillment, and customer engagement. This platform is built on scalable, API-driven services and shared platform capabilities that support reusable solutions across the enterprise .   

   

 The Software Engineer II (SE II) role is a fully productive, professional engineer responsible for designing, building, and delivering software solutions with independent ownership and execution accountability . This role contributes directly to platform development by building backend services, APIs, and system components that support scalable, high-performing digital experiences.   

   

 Impact of the Role   

 Delivers scalable services and features that power Varsity Brands’ digital platform   

 
 Improves engineering velocity and system reliability through high-quality development practices   

 
 Contributes to platform consistency, reuse, and performance across engineering teams   

 
 S upports the transition to scalable, API-driven services and shared platform capabilities   

 
 Drives adoption of shared platform capabilities through consistent, reusable service development   

 
   

 WHAT YOU WILL DO:    

 Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs aligned to platform architecture   

 
 Own end-to-end delivery of features, from design through deployment and support   

 
 Troubleshoot and resolve production issues , identifying root causes and implementing solutions   

 
 Apply testing, performance optimization, and secure coding practices   

 
 Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and system reliability improvements   

 
 Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and other engineering teams to deliver solutions   

 

 Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to solution approaches   

 
 Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers (including SE I)   

 
 Design components and services within established architecture, making independent technical decisions within defined patterns   

 
   

 Key Performance Indicators   

 Success in this role will be measured through :   

 Ownership and delivery of features and services   

 
 Code quality, scalability, and performance of delivered solutions   

 
 Reduction in defects and production incidents   

 
 Contribution to team productivity and engineering practices   

 
 Effectiveness in cross-functional collaboration and delivery   

 
   

 QUALIFICATIONS: 
 Knowledge, Skills, Abilities   

 The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following capabilities:   

 Tech nical Knowledge   

 Strong understanding of backend systems and service-based architecture   

 
 Working knowledge of cloud environments and distributed systems   

 
 Understanding of system design principles and data modeling   

 
 Technical Skills   

 Proficiency in Java and backend development frameworks   

 

 Ability to :   

 
 Design and build RESTful APIs   

 
 Optimize system performance and scalability   

 
 Implement testing strategies and debugging techniques   

 
 Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and production systems   

 
 Cognitive & Problem-Solving Abilities   

 Solves moderately complex technical problems independently   

 
 Navigates ambiguity within defined domains   

 
 Diagnoses root causes and implements effective solutions   

 
 Collaboration & Influence   

 Collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, QA)   

 
 Contributes to team-level improvements and engineering practices   

 
 Provides guidance and support to junior engineers   

 
 Execution & Ownership   

 Demonstrates accountability for end-to-end delivery outcomes   

 
 Balances speed, quality, and reliability in execution   

 
   

 Education, Certification and Experience   

 Required :   

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Engineering, or related technical discipline; or equivalent combination of education and experience   

 

 2 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience   

 
   

 Physical Demands and/or Work Environment   

 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions .    


 


 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. 
   
 OUR VALUES 
 Service -  We lead with heart. We champion community. 
 Passion -  We love what we do. It fuels our purpose. 
 Integrity -  We do what we promise. We own our actions and decisions. 
 Respect -  We earn it by giving it. Because everyone deserves it. 
 Innovation -  We never stop striving to be better. For ourselves and our community. 
 Transparency -  We are committed to openness and honesty in everything we do. 
   
 OUR BENEFITS 
 We are committed to putting you and your families first. For benefits eligible roles, we offer a variety of choices and costs as well as program enhancements that align with our responsibility to elevate the employee experience. Some of our offerings include: 
 Comprehensive Health Care Benefits 
 HSA Employer Contribution/ FSA Opportunities 
 Wellbeing Program 
 401(k) plan with company matching 
 Company paid Life, AD&D, and Short-Term Disability 
 Generous My Time Off & Paid Holidays 
 Varsity Brands Ownership Program 
 Employee Resource Groups 
 Access to Financial Coaching and member-owned Credit Union 
 St. Jude Partnership & Volunteer Opportunities 
 Employee Perks including discounts on personal apparel and equipment! 
   
 Eligibility for company-sponsored benefits is determined by scheduled work hours, and the terms of the applicable benefit plans. Benefit offerings and eligibility requirements may vary by position and are subject to change in accordance with plan documents and applicable law. 
   
 Varsity Brands companies are equal opportunity employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.
